title: Increase pull-quote
description: A quiet customer quote with the opening mark hanging into the margin, followed by a small 32px logo tile, the speaker's name and a tiny grey role line. Large grey or small main-colour text.
notes: the mark tile is 32px; fill it with a logo or a lucide icon on a token colour
name: increase-quote

props.name: quote
props.description: the quote, without quotation marks (they are added, the opening one hanging in the margin)

props.name: mark
props.description: a 32px square mark beside the name: a logo or an icon on a tile

props.name: size
props.description: lg: 18px grey text (beside a lead statement) · sm: 15px text in the main colour (in a row)
